tagline: Detects propeller sound with the microphone
notificationsOff: Notifications are off. You won't get drone alerts while the app is in the background.
noteIdle: After you start, hold the phone still for 3 seconds while it learns the background sounds.
noteCalibrating: Hold the phone still and stay quiet. {percent}
noteIgnored: A harmonic matches a device sound you ignored, so no alert is raised.
noteDrone: Continuous propeller harmonic: {hz} Hz and its multiples.
noteSuspect: A harmonic sound is present. It must last a few more seconds and behave like a drone to count as one.
noteVeto: The harmonic sound is locked to mains power or perfectly steady, so it was treated as a device such as a fan or air conditioner.
noteDeviceLike: A harmonic sound is present, but it resembles a device such as a fan or motor.
steadyHum: This hum is very steady. It may be a fan, air conditioner or generator. If it belongs to your surroundings, tap "{ignore}".
cuesLegend: Red cues point to a drone, green cues to a device such as a fan or motor.
spectrumIdle: Start listening on the {listen} tab. The sound spectrum then scrolls here from right to left.
legendText: The strip on top shows the state. A drone shows up as evenly spaced horizontal lines; the marks on the right edge are the harmonics found.
logEmpty: No detections yet. When a drone is detected, its time, duration and frequency appear here.
clearLogBody: All detections will be deleted from this phone.
ignoredEmpty: None yet. If a fan or air conditioner triggers an alert, tap "{ignore}" on the {listen} screen. It won't raise an alert again.
zoneIndoorText: Next to fans, air conditioners or fridges. Alerts only on a clear drone sound.
zoneCityText: Balanced. Keeps false alarms in check around traffic and crowds.
zoneOpenText: In quiet open areas it also catches faint, distant drones; slightly more false alarms.
alertsHint: Notifications arrive while the app is in the background.
aboutIntro: Propellers produce steady tones at the blade-pass frequency (100–500 Hz for most drones) and at its exact multiples. The app first learns the steady hums around you, then looks for new harmonic sounds.
aboutFanTitle: Telling a drone from a fan
aboutFan: Drone-specific cues are weighed: the signature of several rotors, a varying rotor speed, a fluctuating level, and not being locked to 50/60 Hz mains power. Fans and air conditioners usually have a single rotor, a steady speed and are locked to the mains.
aboutYam: Google's YAMNet audio model also runs on the phone and, every half second, says whether the sound resembles a drone. The decision is the average of both opinions; what YAMNet hears when listening starts is factored out.
aboutPrivacy: Audio is never recorded or sent off the phone. Both models run on the phone.
aboutLimits: Range is short; wind and traffic reduce it further. Motorcycles, lawn mowers, saws and other engines can cause false alarms. Do not rely on it as the only source for safety-critical decisions.
promptText: Detection is tuned to your surroundings. Pick the closest match; you can change it any time in {settings}.
permIntro: Your phone will ask next. Here's why.
permMicText: Listens for propeller sound. Audio is analysed on the phone and never recorded or sent.
permNotifText: An SOS alert when a drone is heard, even while the app is in the background.
errMicBlocked: Microphone access is off. Allow {app} to use the microphone in Settings.
errMicNeeded: Microphone access is needed to listen.
errMicUnavailable: Couldn't open the microphone. Another app may be using it.
errMicBusy: Another app is using the microphone.
errBackground: Couldn't start listening in the background. Try again with the app open.
noticeInterrupted: Listening paused because of a call or other audio.
noticeSilenced: The microphone is silent right now. Another app may be using it.
noticeStopped: Listening was stopped from the notification.
ongoingText: You'll be notified if a drone sound is detected.
channelListenDesc: Ongoing notification while the app is listening
channelAlertDesc: Sent when a drone sound is detected (SOS tone)
alertBody: Continuous propeller harmonic at {hz} Hz and its multiples. Tap for details.
micUsage: {app} listens through the microphone to detect drone propeller sound. Audio is never recorded or sent off the phone.
